headline: Apple officially unveiled its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, and it’ll start at $1
body: Apple officially unveiled its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, and it’ll start at $1,999 🤯📱 The new phone unfolds into a 7.6-inch display, giving users more room to watch videos and run apps side by side. It’s set to go on sale October 23, marking a major change from the iPhone design we’ve gotten used to. 👀 Are you spending $2,000 on this or keeping your current phone? 😭
